data.name: course_offering_overviews
data.sql: CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "course_offering_overviews" ("id", "course_code", "semester", "number", "name_zh", "name_en", "credits", "hours", "phase", "course_type", "status", "language", "remarks", "enrolled", "withdrawn", "fetched_at") AS SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."course_code" AS "course_code", "t0"."semester" AS "semester", "t0"."number" AS "number", COALESCE("t0"."name_zh", "t1"."name_zh") AS "name_zh", COALESCE("t0"."name_en", "t1"."name_en") AS "name_en", COALESCE("t0"."credits", "t1"."credits") AS "credits", COALESCE("t0"."hours", "t1"."hours") AS "hours", "t0"."phase" AS "phase", "t0"."course_type" AS "course_type", "t0"."status" AS "status", "t0"."language" AS "language", "t0"."remarks" AS "remarks", "t0"."enrolled" AS "enrolled", "t0"."withdrawn" AS "withdrawn", "t0"."fetched_at" AS "fetched_at" FROM "course_offerings" "t0" LEFT OUTER JOIN "courses" "t1" ON "t1"."code" = "t0"."course_code"

data.name: course_table_slots
data.sql: CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "course_table_slots" ("id", "number", "semester", "name_zh", "name_en", "credits", "hours", "day_of_week", "period", "classroom_name_zh", "classroom_name_en") AS SELECT "t1"."id" AS "id", "t1"."number" AS "number", "t1"."semester" AS "semester", COALESCE("t1"."name_zh", "t2"."name_zh") AS "name_zh", COALESCE("t1"."name_en", "t2"."name_en") AS "name_en", COALESCE("t1"."credits", "t2"."credits") AS "credits", COALESCE("t1"."hours", "t2"."hours") AS "hours", "t0"."day_of_week" AS "day_of_week", "t0"."period" AS "period", "t3"."name_zh" AS "classroom_name_zh", "t3"."name_en" AS "classroom_name_en" FROM "schedules" "t0" INNER JOIN "course_offerings" "t1" ON "t1"."id" = "t0"."course_offering" LEFT OUTER JOIN "courses" "t2" ON "t2"."code" = "t1"."course_code" LEFT OUTER JOIN "classrooms" "t3" ON "t3"."id" = "t0"."classroom" WHERE "t1"."in_course_table" = 1

data.name: score_details
data.sql: CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "score_details" ("id", "user", "semester", "score", "status", "code", "name_zh", "name_en", "number") AS SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."user" AS "user", "t0"."semester" AS "semester", "t0"."score" AS "score", "t0"."status" AS "status", "t1"."code" AS "code", COALESCE("t2"."name_zh", "t1"."name_zh") AS "name_zh", COALESCE("t2"."name_en", "t1"."name_en") AS "name_en", "t2"."number" AS "number" FROM "scores" "t0" INNER JOIN "courses" "t1" ON "t1"."id" = "t0"."course" LEFT OUTER JOIN "course_offerings" "t2" ON "t2"."id" = "t0"."course_offering"

data.name: user_academic_summaries
data.sql: CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "user_academic_summaries" ("id", "user", "semester", "year", "term", "average", "conduct", "total_credits", "credits_passed", "note", "gpa") AS SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."user" AS "user", "t0"."semester" AS "semester", "t1"."year" AS "year", "t1"."term" AS "term", "t0"."average" AS "average", "t0"."conduct" AS "conduct", "t0"."total_credits" AS "total_credits", "t0"."credits_passed" AS "credits_passed", "t0"."note" AS "note", "t0"."gpa" AS "gpa" FROM "user_semester_summaries" "t0" INNER JOIN "semesters" "t1" ON "t1"."id" = "t0"."semester"

data.name: user_registrations
data.sql: CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "user_registrations" ("year", "term", "class_name", "enrollment_status", "graduated") AS SELECT "t1"."year" AS "year", "t1"."term" AS "term", "t0"."class_name" AS "class_name", "t0"."enrollment_status" AS "enrollment_status", "t0"."graduated" AS "graduated" FROM "user_semester_summaries" "t0" INNER JOIN "semesters" "t1" ON "t1"."id" = "t0"."semester"

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name_zh" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NULL, "date_of_birth" INTEGER NULL, "program_zh" TEXT NULL, "program_en" TEXT NULL, "department_zh" TEXT NULL, "department_en" TEXT NULL, "avatar_filename" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "password_expires_in_days" INTEGER NULL, "semesters_fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "score_data_fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "calendar_fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "application_catalog_fetched_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "portal_application_categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "distinguished_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_zh" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("user", "distinguished_name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "portal_applications" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES portal_application_categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_zh" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NULL, "icon_url" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("category", "code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "portal_application_favorites" ("user" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "application_code" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user", "application_code"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "students" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "semesters" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "term" INTEGER NOT NULL, "in_course_semester_list" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("in_course_semester_list" IN (0, 1)), "in_score_semester_list" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("in_score_semester_list" IN (0, 1)), "course_table_fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("year", "term"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "courses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "credits" REAL NOT NULL, "hours" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name_zh" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NULL, "description_zh" TEXT NULL, "description_en" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "departments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name_zh" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "teachers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name_zh" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "classes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "semester" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semesters (id), "name_zh" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("code", "semester"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "classrooms" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name_zh" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "course_offerings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "course_code" TEXT NULL, "semester" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semesters (id), "number" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name_zh" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NULL, "credits" REAL NULL, "hours" INTEGER NULL, "phase" INTEGER NULL, "course_type" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "remarks" TEXT NULL, "in_course_table" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("in_course_table" IN (0, 1)), "enrolled" INTEGER NULL, "withdrawn" INTEGER NULL, "student_roster_fetched_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "teacher_semesters" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "teacher" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teachers (id), "semester" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semesters (id), "email" TEXT NULL, "department" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES departments (id), "title" TEXT NULL, "teaching_hours" REAL NULL, "office_hours_note" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("teacher", "semester"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "course_offering_teachers" ("course_offering" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES course_offerings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "teacher_semester" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teacher_semesters (id), PRIMARY KEY ("course_offering", "teacher_semester"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "course_offering_classes" ("course_offering" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES course_offerings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "class_entity" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES classes (id), PRIMARY KEY ("course_offering", "class_entity"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "course_offering_students" ("course_offering" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES course_offerings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "student" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id), PRIMARY KEY ("course_offering", "student"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "course_offering" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES course_offerings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "day_of_week" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period" INTEGER NOT NULL, "classroom" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES classrooms (id), UNIQUE ("course_offering", "day_of_week", "period"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "syllabuses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "course_offering" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES course_offerings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "teacher" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teachers (id), "language" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("course_offering", "teacher", "language"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "syllabus_sections" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "syllabus" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES syllabuses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("syllabus", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "materials" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "course_offering" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES course_offerings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NULL, "href" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("course_offering", "href"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "teacher_office_hours" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "teacher_semester" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teacher_semesters (id), "day_of_week" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_hour" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_hour" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("teacher_semester", "day_of_week", "start_hour", "start_minute"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scores" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "semester" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semesters (id), "course" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES courses (id), "course_offering" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES course_offerings (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "score" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_semester_summaries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "semester" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semesters (id), "average" REAL NULL, "conduct" REAL NULL, "total_credits" REAL NULL, "credits_passed" REAL NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "gpa" REAL NULL, "class_name" TEXT NULL, "enrollment_status" TEXT NULL, "registered" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("registered" IN (0, 1)), "graduated" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("graduated" IN (0, 1)), UNIQUE ("user", "semester"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_semester_summary_tutors" ("summary" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user_semester_summaries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "teacher_semester" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teacher_semesters (id), PRIMARY KEY ("summary", "teacher_semester"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_semester_summary_cadre_roles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "summary" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user_semester_summaries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("summary", "role"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_semester_rankings" ("summary" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user_semester_summaries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ranking_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "semester_rank" INTEGER NOT NULL, "semester_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grand_total_rank" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grand_total_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("summary", "ranking_type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calendar_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "portal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end" INTEGER NOT NULL, "all_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("all_day" IN (0, 1)), "title" TEXT NULL, "place" TEXT NULL, "content" TEXT NULL, "owner_name" TEXT NULL, "creator_name" TEXT NULL);

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "course_offering_overviews" ("id", "course_code", "semester", "number", "name_zh", "name_en", "credits", "hours", "phase", "course_type", "status", "language", "remarks", "enrolled", "withdrawn", "fetched_at") AS SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."course_code" AS "course_code", "t0"."semester" AS "semester", "t0"."number" AS "number", COALESCE("t0"."name_zh", "t1"."name_zh") AS "name_zh", COALESCE("t0"."name_en", "t1"."name_en") AS "name_en", COALESCE("t0"."credits", "t1"."credits") AS "credits", COALESCE("t0"."hours", "t1"."hours") AS "hours", "t0"."phase" AS "phase", "t0"."course_type" AS "course_type", "t0"."status" AS "status", "t0"."language" AS "language", "t0"."remarks" AS "remarks", "t0"."enrolled" AS "enrolled", "t0"."withdrawn" AS "withdrawn", "t0"."fetched_at" AS "fetched_at" FROM "course_offerings" "t0" LEFT OUTER JOIN "courses" "t1" ON "t1"."code" = "t0"."course_code"

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "course_table_slots" ("id", "number", "semester", "name_zh", "name_en", "credits", "hours", "day_of_week", "period", "classroom_name_zh", "classroom_name_en") AS SELECT "t1"."id" AS "id", "t1"."number" AS "number", "t1"."semester" AS "semester", COALESCE("t1"."name_zh", "t2"."name_zh") AS "name_zh", COALESCE("t1"."name_en", "t2"."name_en") AS "name_en", COALESCE("t1"."credits", "t2"."credits") AS "credits", COALESCE("t1"."hours", "t2"."hours") AS "hours", "t0"."day_of_week" AS "day_of_week", "t0"."period" AS "period", "t3"."name_zh" AS "classroom_name_zh", "t3"."name_en" AS "classroom_name_en" FROM "schedules" "t0" INNER JOIN "course_offerings" "t1" ON "t1"."id" = "t0"."course_offering" LEFT OUTER JOIN "courses" "t2" ON "t2"."code" = "t1"."course_code" LEFT OUTER JOIN "classrooms" "t3" ON "t3"."id" = "t0"."classroom" WHERE "t1"."in_course_table" = 1

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "score_details" ("id", "user", "semester", "score", "status", "code", "name_zh", "name_en", "number") AS SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."user" AS "user", "t0"."semester" AS "semester", "t0"."score" AS "score", "t0"."status" AS "status", "t1"."code" AS "code", COALESCE("t2"."name_zh", "t1"."name_zh") AS "name_zh", COALESCE("t2"."name_en", "t1"."name_en") AS "name_en", "t2"."number" AS "number" FROM "scores" "t0" INNER JOIN "courses" "t1" ON "t1"."id" = "t0"."course" LEFT OUTER JOIN "course_offerings" "t2" ON "t2"."id" = "t0"."course_offering"

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "user_academic_summaries" ("id", "user", "semester", "year", "term", "average", "conduct", "total_credits", "credits_passed", "note", "gpa") AS SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."user" AS "user", "t0"."semester" AS "semester", "t1"."year" AS "year", "t1"."term" AS "term", "t0"."average" AS "average", "t0"."conduct" AS "conduct", "t0"."total_credits" AS "total_credits", "t0"."credits_passed" AS "credits_passed", "t0"."note" AS "note", "t0"."gpa" AS "gpa" FROM "user_semester_summaries" "t0" INNER JOIN "semesters" "t1" ON "t1"."id" = "t0"."semester"

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "user_registrations" ("year", "term", "class_name", "enrollment_status", "graduated") AS SELECT "t1"."year" AS "year", "t1"."term" AS "term", "t0"."class_name" AS "class_name", "t0"."enrollment_status" AS "enrollment_status", "t0"."graduated" AS "graduated" FROM "user_semester_summaries" "t0" INNER JOIN "semesters" "t1" ON "t1"."id" = "t0"."semester"
CREATE INDEX class_semester ON classes (semester)
CREATE INDEX course_offering_course_code ON course_offerings (course_code)
CREATE INDEX course_offering_semester ON course_offerings (semester)
CREATE INDEX schedule_course_offering ON schedules (course_offering)
CREATE INDEX material_course_offering ON materials (course_offering)
CREATE INDEX teacher_semester_semester ON teacher_semesters (semester)
CREATE INDEX teacher_office_hour_teacher_semester ON teacher_office_hours (teacher_semester)
CREATE INDEX score_user ON scores (user)
CREATE INDEX user_semester_summary_user ON user_semester_summaries (user)
